action.question: How do you want the 5 forked sessions resumed on mini?

questions.question: How do you want the 5 forked sessions resumed on mini?

options.label: Open each in a new Terminal window/tab
options.description: Spawn 5 Terminal.app windows, each running `cd ~/dev/ai-harness && claude -r <uuid>`. You drive them interactively from there. Visible, easy to close, but 5 new windows.

options.label: Open each in the Claude desktop app
options.description: If `claude` has a desktop-open mode (e.g. `claude --open <uuid>` or a `claude://` URL), use that so they appear in your app session list. Cleanest if it works — needs me to probe the CLI first.

options.label: Headless wake (claude -p "resume")
options.description: Run `claude -r <uuid> -p "resume"` for each in the background. The sessions get a single turn that re-anchors them as a cse_ in the cloud list, but they don't stay interactive. Useful if the goal is just "get them visible/connected".
